<column-break/>

...to embalm with the apple, and a binding of blue thread <note>original: *techelet*</note> that is crumbled. The upper [seal] is like the ewes, and its beginning is like the frost that is near. For the "Seal" also teaches about the upper shortness, just as these are seals in the ground, releasing for all, breaking open, and then returning and bringing back in—releasing, breaking, and digging. These are "small seals." 

And this "Apple" <note>likely a metaphorical reference to a specific Sefirah or a geometric shape in the Merkabah</note> belongs to the coverings, and it is itself the "Shortness." This teaches us to compare all "Meal Offerings" <term>*Menachot*; grain offerings in the Temple</term>. And one should contemplate this in a dream, for the world contains everything from these matters and the power of the upper hidden things. This is to say, it is intellectual, and it is the beginning of all "Meal Offerings" due to His leadership, previously in the **Secret of Gilgul** <term>reincarnation or the cyclic rotation of the celestial spheres</term>. 

For through Him, the mundane things descend, and through Him, all other existing things are elevated. From the sweetness of His light and His preparations, they said: "Behold the beginning of the rests." Do not be mistaken to say that He is the "First Matter" <note>a philosophical term for the substratum of all physical things</note>. For it is known that the scholars of the constellations <note>astronomers/astrologers</note> were divided regarding the external "Foundations" as per his explanation, for the "Spirit of God" is hidden. This secret is in the verse: "And the Spirit of God hovered" <note>Genesis 1:2</note>. See also *Genesis Rabbah*.

And behold, these three letters, **Y-H-W** (יהו), He fixed them in His Great Name. The word "Fixed them" <note>original: *keva'an*</note> is from the language of "gathering" and "shield" and "the helmets [of the giants] are upon me all around." The definition of *Keva* is something that surrounds the head. According to this, "He fixed them in His Great Name" means He surrounded them with His Great Name in the wheels of the Chariot <term>*Merkabah*; the Divine Throne-Chariot</term> of the heavens with the Name Y-H-W and A-H-W. And there, they are the ones who encompass all the "rests." And that which is in the "Crown of the Universe" <note>original: *B-K-A*, perhaps referring to Keter</note> called the "Full Height," the "Crown of the Universe" surrounds His Great Name which is called "Strong" <note>original: *Chasun*</note>. And it is Y-H-W that surrounds like the firmament surrounds all the rests and that which is within it. 

And this is the meaning of "He fixed them in His Great Name," from the expression "all that is fixed" <note>original: *kol kavua*</note>, like a camp upon a camp. That is, He fixed them in His Great Name, and they are sixty [units] fixed within it so they do not move from there to another place. And as they said in *Genesis Rabbah* regarding the three letters...

# Chapter 1 — The Rambam <note>original: *ha-Rambam*; likely a reference to Maimonides, though the text primarily discusses the views of Nachmanides (Ramban), a common attribution overlap in such manuscripts</note>, of blessed memory

He is to me; the Simple, the Actual is He. And the Simple, the Simple is He, and so on. These are the letters of the **Ten Sefirot** <term>the ten creative powers or emanations in Kabbalah</term> that revolve upon the wheel, and at times... His name is *Kuzu* <note>original: *Kuzu Bemuchsas*; a divine name formed by shifting the letters of the name Y-H-W-H forward by one in the alphabet</note>.
The calculation of twenty-eight, and so on, is according to the way of the Ten Sefirot. If so, this calculation has a great principle regarding the way of contemplation. Therefore, our Sages of blessed memory said: "The *Shekhinah* <term>the Divine Presence</term> did not descend lower than ten handbreadths."
And in the "House of Choice" <note>original: *Beit ha-Behirah*</note> of the great Kabbalist **Rabbi Moses ben Nachman** <note>Nachmanides</note>, of blessed memory, it is explained that the world was created with intentional purpose.
How so? 7 times Y-H <note>original: *Yah*, the letters Yod (10) and Heh (5) equaling 15</note> are 105. 9 times 9 are 81. 8 times 8 are 64. 7 times 7 are 49. 6 times 6 are 36. 5 times 5 are 25. 4 times 4 are 16. 3 times 3 are 9. 2 times 2 are 4. 1 time 1 is one. Through the secret of this calculation, He guards Himself in His course.
And according to the secret of this wisdom, the letter **H** <note>original: *Heh*</note> indicates the Essence, as it was, it is, and it will be, though it is written in a condensed form <note>original: *Beiharti*</note> above. Through the secret of calculation, He guards Himself in His course.
And according to the secret of this wisdom, the letter **H** indicates the secret of the twelve. And behold, the Master of Kabbalah wrote concerning "the few," and it is not far off; for *Beiharti* <note>an acronymic permutation</note> is the secret of *Yedid* <note>original: "Friend," numerical value 14</note>. All of this rises and doubles the permutation for life, to be as "Yours." And this is the secret of: "Yours is the foundation to establish you," and to say to you: "It is good for Israel."
And this attribute is the one that has mercy on Israel and strikes the nations. And this is: "And for you, yourself, and for your people."
And the secret of *TNMN* <note>a mystical acronym</note> is placed in the permutation of thought. For the letter *Het* (H) is exchanged for *Tav* (T) in the language of *Beihat* <note>a substitution system</note>. The letter *Dalet* (D) is exchanged for *Tav* (T). It is exchanged through the way of substitution in the way of the letter *Heh* (H). It is exchanged through the way of substitution with the letter *Yod* (Y), as in "Assembly." The letter *Gimel* (G) is exchanged in the permutation through substitution with the letter *Yod* (Y), like the letter *Heh* (H). Behold, for life: *TNMN*.

### The Commentary of the Ramban <note>Nachmanides</note>, of blessed memory

He did not return to specify this Mishnah except to make known which of them are the "extremities" <term>the directions or boundaries of the physical world</term>, which are the core of the matter. These are the hopes within them for the four winds <note>directions</note> he mentioned at first, which are found in the letters. And the letters he mentioned are nothing other than the upright structures of the extremities that exist within them. Through them, the twenty-two letters spread out into every single thing, from the beginning to the end, and so too upon the ten. Thus, every matter of place and language does not need further explanation, for from it, everything spreads out over the ten. The chapter is finished.

# The Rambam <note>Moses Maimonides, 1135–1204</note>, of blessed memory — Chapter 1, Mishnah 1 — The Ra’avad <note>Abraham ben David of Posquières</note>, of blessed memory

<meta>catchword: according to</meta>

There He called him according to the power of His might, as it is said regarding the Teacher, Rabbi Aaron <note>Likely referring to Aaron of Baghdad, a seminal figure in the transmission of mystical secrets to Europe</note> (RA'AH) and his goodness in all things. And these are his words: There, the desires of Aaron—his heart presses them to cut a horn, and when they entered from the horn to the fortress <note>original: *metron*; likely a reference to a guarded or measured space</note>. For the Name, the totality of all, called him by the name of **Brightness** <note>original: *Zohar*</note>. Regarding the matter of the district, it is written: "In it is *Chur* and in it is *Chur*," <note>original: *chur*; a wordplay on "white," "hole," and "Horeb/Sinai"</note> for He is the **Light of the world**. And like the material of the hands, when a man dies, his wisdom dies with him. And behold the interiority, for all of it is righteousness, for it is a small point. The palm <note>original: *kaf*; means both "palm of a hand" and "scale of a balance"</note> of my merit and the palm of liability, and the liability tips the scale, as it is written. And this is the secret that the author of the *Sefer Yetzirah* <term>The Book of Formation; the foundational text of Jewish mysticism</term> wrote: "Three mothers: *Aleph, Mem, Shin*; a scale of merit and a scale of liability, and the tongue of the decree <note>original: *lashon chok*</note> decides between them." And this is the secret of "Abounding in Kindness," which leans toward kindness. These are the words of the Teacher, Rabbi Joseph.

Simplicity may be spoken of in several ways. Kindness is one of them; the holy garments belong to them in hiddenness. And all of them, by way of simple kindness, have existence. His emanation is within those that extend the Glory. And the word "doubles" <note>original: *kefulot*; referring to the seven Hebrew letters that have two sounds</note> is from the language of doubling... from the sea, it is lacking. From there, like branches extending from His kindness, branches upon branches. Kindness, at the time of its beginning, has branches upon branches, and it has leaves, flowers, and fruits to bestow its flow, from which a source springs forth... the source that springs from it to the upper beings is from the **World of the Root** <term>Olam ha-Ikar; the primary or essential world</term>. Height for the lower beings from the one who crowns, from which it flows... it is written as standing on its own. Some of the writings are lacking, and its power is to suppress the powers of the one who denies. In these writings, the ailments are from the [lack of] kindness. The writings are equal in all judgment and support and every kind of book. To use a metaphor, the source—all of them are like stars to them, of blessed memory. And every kind and form is lacking the medicine of kindness within judgment. And it changes within judgment... to be an actor according to these actions. And just as there is a "palm" [scale] of the hand, so too there are the "palms" [soles] of the feet.

<column-break/>

The sages of medicine <note>referring to the medieval Galenic medical tradition</note> designated the organs of man according to the names of the elements. They designated the **Brain** by the name of the **White Humor** <term>Phlegm; associated with the element of Water</term>. And they designated the **Spleen** by the name of the **Black** [Humor] <term>Black Bile; associated with Earth</term>. And the **Liver**, the **Red** <term>Blood; associated with Air</term>. And the **Gallbladder**, the **White-Green** <term>Yellow Bile; associated with Fire</term>. These correspond to Fire, Earth, Wind, and Water. And I do not think that any person in his days would think that the sages of the Name [the Kabbalists] believe the brain is the humor alone, or the green [bile] alone, or the liver from the red alone, or the spleen from the black alone. Rather, each one of them is composed of all of them, and all the time, in all the organs of man. And such is the law regarding the rest of the actions and the "extensions" whose foundation is as we have said. The sages of actions [call them] "simple" relative to that which is composed of them, or because they have a "substitute." And you should know that the language of the grammarians—"and he shall strip off his clothes"—means he is changing, and mercy is his cloak before his eyes. And they stripped off... and they go stripped. See in the book that they shall be as a double-doubled, recognized and doubled. For he is a recognized double and doubled in his doubling and his cycle, like a wheel. And there is a parable for this: a wheel that encompasses. In the wheels, it has branches, and branches upon branches, and branches of branches. Thus is the **Tree of Life** <term>Etz HaChayim</term> which is called "Man," and in his hand is all that is withheld from him. And everything is in doubt. However, the scripture is lacking from it, from it to the upper beings. And so for every single kind of the metals, it is lacking, and in their hiddenness, the Name is lacking as if covering it. And not his merit... to do the kindness of his fellow... grace and kindness to elevate him to his fellow. So there are writings to support the throne, which is the salt <note>perhaps meaning the "essence" or "preservative"</note> as the sages [said] that its essence is the source of light and kindness, which changes in every designation. Every single kind of merit is lacking for him in the upper realms, of blessed memory, from His kindness, may He be blessed. And according to the merit and the support, it shall be... a simple engraving. And for the merit of the Torah. And for the Lord, may He be blessed, to be as it says: "Let us lift our hearts to our hands [palms] to God in Heaven." And just as there are the soles of His feet, so he is supported by the **Scale of Merit** and my merit.

# Chapter 2, Mishnah 1 — The Rambam <note>Pseudo-Maimonides; while this manuscript attributes this commentary to the famous philosopher Maimonides, scholars generally believe these mystical commentaries were written by later authors using his name for authority.</note>, of blessed memory

For this reason, they were guided by the shorthand used by writers to discuss everything in brief words. This was explained by Rabbi Hesron in the *Book of Pardes* <note>Likely referring to the *Pardes Rimonim* or a similar kabbalistic compendium</note>, as follows: He said "Ten Sephirot of nothingness" <term>Sefirot Belimah; the ten primordial numbers or dimensions of creation</term> so that the student would not mistakenly think that the "ten depths" mentioned earlier are themselves the ten Sephirot. Rather, after he counted them, he says: One, two, three, four... these are the ten Sephirot: The Breath of the Living God, Air from Breath, Water from Air, Fire from Water, and the six directions: Height, Depth, East, West, South, and North. We do not read them as "North then South," because South is the most distinguished direction and is therefore associated with the "Right."
The chapter is completed. And when we explain it at length, your mind will be settled, for every secret will not be hidden from you.

->The Commentary of the Ramban <note>Nachmanides, 1194–1270</note>, of blessed memory<-

The text does not read "twenty-two" until it reaches "merit." He mentions the "Three Fathers" <note>An alternative term for the "Three Mothers"</note> and their offspring: the "Doubles" and the "Simples" which have no double form in their shape. 
**Three letters: Aleph, Mem, Shin.** They are called "Foundation" because there is no permanence for anything in the world without them. He only mentions the "foundation" for that which emerges from them, for they are the basis through which a person recognizes the good.

Regarding this sixth discourse, we shall look correctly to conclude their words upon the entirety of writing—the totality of the world—with brief words and the explanation of the Rabbi <note>referring to a previous authority</note> regarding the omission in the *Book of the Orchard* <term>Sefer ha-Pardes; a reference to Cordovero's work or a similar title</term> and to the material in the *Book of Creation* <term>Sefer Yetzirah</term>. # Commentary of the Ramban, of blessed memory <note>original: Ramban zal</note>

These are indeed the very law of the currency! <note>original: "chak ha-matbe'a"; a metaphor for the standard or fixed form of divine expression</note> Through all their activities, they camp according to the "tongue"; "at the mouth of the Lord they camped, and at the mouth of the Lord they journeyed" <note>Numbers 9:23</note> regarding the totality. So too, the tongue is the deciding factor between the upper world and the lower world, and between the holy and the profane. It decides what the dominant thought intends, for it reveals every hidden thing. However, it remains silent, for it is a "still small voice" <note>1 Kings 19:12</note> and a "faithful secret of the spirit that conceals a matter." This is from the side of the attribute of Mercy <term>Chesed; the divine attribute of expansive kindness</term> which is surrounded [by light]. It is written regarding the unique Unity that He is "perfect," and one perceives Him within one's "kidneys" <note>in ancient psychology, the kidneys were seen as the seat of counsel or conscience</note>; its likeness in the upper world is "To You, silence is praise" <note>Psalm 65:2</note>. Every expression of "silence" hints at Mercy, which does not sound a voice of humming, crying, or groaning. It is known that the difference is due to the humming of the spirit. From the source of the two attributes—which are Fire for silence and Silence for hearing—as it is said from the side of Judgment <term>Din; the divine attribute of restriction</term>, "May the Lord forgive" to remember. "Remember" <note>Zachor</note> is for the memory of Ekron <note>likely a reference to a specific kabbalistic geographical or numerical correspondence</note>, and this division is the deciding law between them. The explanation is that the Crown <term>Keter; the highest of the Ten Sefirot</term> is called the "Law of Aleph." Just as Repentance <term>Teshuvah</term> decides between merit and guilt, so does the Crown decide between silence and removal. It hints at the powers of Judgment <term>Gevurot</term> descending until they reach Mercy; neither Judgment nor the middle path can decide [without it].

here is the word in the name of the twenty-two letters: He engraved them, hewed them, weighed them, exchanged them, combined them, and formed through them the soul of every creature and the soul of everything destined to be formed.

Behold the secret of every manner of creation in its totality through the twenty-two letters. It is one, and all this secret is included within the depth of the Crown <term>Keter</term>. It says from your purification until the subtle point <note>original: "dak duka"</note>, "Return here" and that which is not. For me, every creature is from the twenty-two letters. "He engraved them" refers to the clarification of the parts of each and every letter until its form was established. Each and every letter was formed into letters, whether in light, in water, or in fire. He engraved them in the deep <term>Tehom</term>, as it is said: "When He engraved a circle upon the face of the deep" <note>Proverbs 8:27</note>. He engraved them in the heavens, as it is said: "You have stretched out the heavens with power." Regarding water, it is said: "The voice of the Lord is upon the waters." Regarding light, it is said...

### Commentary of the Ramban, of blessed memory

**He engraved them:** Each and every letter has its own engraving. **And He hewed them:** This refers to "hewing" to separate one from another. **He weighed them:** As it is written, "To make a weight for the spirit" <note>Job 28:25</note>; He weighed the parts of the spirit. **And He exchanged them:** One with another, as he said: "and all the exchange and the substitution" is there. **He combined them:** He paired one letter with another. **And all through them:** He formed through them every creature and the names that are in the world to come, which are destined to come into being and be perfected.

### The Ra'avad, may his memory be a blessing <note>original: "Ha-Ra'avad Zal"; Rabbi Abraham ben David, a 12th-century French scholar and kabbalist</note>, Chapter 1, Mishnah 2

<meta>catchword: The Maz...</meta>

...as though hidden upon the Hebrew. And behold, all the precious things are engraved in the palm of the "Aleph" <note>This likely refers to the "One" or the first letter, Aleph, representing the divine origin</note>, as it is said: "Behold, I have engraved you on my palms," etc. <note>Isaiah 49:16</note>. And remember that the Lord is within every person, and it is written to know every look of his deeds. For man is but a little vanity. And behold, those who understand and are known to be beloved [by God], the Lord will reveal everything to them, as was said regarding the introduction, to the Eighteen [Benedictions] and the God on high. To say that "in His hand is the soul of every living thing" <note>Job 12:10</note>.

And behold, he explained to you that all the souls and spirits are in His hand, through the secret of: "In Your hand I entrust my spirit" <note>Psalm 31:6</note>. This is the law of merit and the law of guilt. As a portion of the Lord, they are directed and appointed to serve, and He formed us with Your 613 commandments <term>Mitzvot; the 613 religious duties in the Torah</term>, each and every one of them is a "garment" for serving the Blessed One, and the King shall be exalted forever and ever. 

And this is the secret of why we say, "Who has sanctified us with His commandments," for the commandments cause us to be "from the world" and "above the world." This is the secret of why the Holy One, Blessed be He, "wears Tefillin" <note>Tefillin are phylacteries. A famous Talmudic passage (Berakhot 6a) describes God wearing them to show His bond with Israel</note>. And this is the secret: "the Lord is a place for the sanctuary," and He prays with intent and is appeased in "My house of prayer." It is said that He "swore by His right hand and by the arm of His strength" <note>Isaiah 62:8</note>—this refers to the Tefillin. So too, you will find in several places that the Holy One, Blessed be He, "engages in the study of Torah." Likewise, if you scrutinize the words of our Sages of blessed memory and the words of the Prophets, you will find this clearly explained.

Similarly, in the section of the Admonition <note>Referring to the blessings and curses in Leviticus or Deuteronomy</note>, and in several places, you find the "Torah of the ministering angels," as our Sages of blessed memory said regarding the longing: "You who have set Your majesty above the heavens" <note>Psalm 8:2</note> regarding the giving of the Torah. Therefore, there is also punishment and reward among the angels, and a likeness of a "look" [at their deeds]. These are the angels who came to overturn Sodom; because they revealed the secret of the Holy One, Blessed be He, and said "For *we* are destroying [this place]" <note>Genesis 19:13; the Midrash suggests they were punished for taking credit for God's act</note>, they were removed from their watch until the time of our forefather Jacob, when it says: "And behold, the angels of God [ascending and descending]" <note>Genesis 28:12</note>. For during this time, you were minor angels for some years; see Genesis Rabbah <note>A collection of ancient homiletic interpretations of the Book of Genesis</note>. 

From here you learn of the "Scale of Merit" and the "Scale of Guilt" extended to the beings above and the beings below, and everything is according to the Law. Behold, regarding the Scale of Merit and the Scale of Guilt: if a person commits a sin, Heaven forbid, he tips himself and the whole world to the scale of guilt. If he performs one commandment, happy is he! For he has tipped himself and the whole world to the scale of merit <note>This follows a famous teaching in the Talmud, Tractate Kiddushin 40b</note>.

And the phrase "the tongue of the law decides" <note>original: "Lashon chok machri'a"; the central point of the balance</note>—my intention in this explanation is that all the host of heaven stand over him: from his right for merit, from the side of Kindness <term>Chesed; the divine attribute of expansive love</term>, and from his left for guilt, from the side of Judgment <term>Din; the divine attribute of restriction and justice</term>. These teach merit and those teach guilt. Around the Lord, my refuge, there is a King over him; from the "Aleph" <note>Perhaps meaning the One/God</note>, He will be gracious to him and say, "Redeem him from going down to the pit, I have found a ransom" <note>Job 33:24</note>.

The term "Law" (*Chok*) refers to Understanding <term>Binah; the third Sephirah, associated with the "Divine Mother" and logical differentiation</term>, which is the center of life. It decides between the Fire and the Water. It is the cause of the "burden" (Kindness) and the "charge" (Guardianship) of a nation's iniquity, as explained in the heights. 

This is what he meant by "the tongue of the law"; he meant the Spirit <note>original: "Ruach"</note> that decides between them—that He gives you the Spirit to decide between [life] and death. According to the text, this includes the concept of "World, Year, and Soul" <note>original: "Olam, Shanah, Nefesh"; the three dimensions of existence in Sefer Yetzirah</note>. On the Sabbath day, in the world, in the year, and in the soul, there is a "tongue of five" <note>Referring to the five phonetic groups of the Hebrew alphabet</note>. 

And behold, the tongue decides between the upper and lower palate, and between the heart and the brain, and it decides between the Fire and the Water. For through prayer, one may turn the attribute of Judgment into Mercy. But through shameful speech, the attribute of Mercy turns into [Wrath] against him. As our Sages of blessed memory said: "Everyone knows why a bride enters the canopy <note>original: "Kallah nichneset le-chuppah"; a euphemism for the purpose of marriage</note>, but anyone who debases his speech, even if a decree of seventy years of good was made for him, it is turned against him for evil," as it is said: "For all this His anger is not turned away, but His hand is stretched out still" <note>Isaiah 9:11</note>. See Tractate Ketubot <note>Tractate of the Talmud dealing with marriage contracts</note>. 

And he said "the tongue of the law" to mean Understanding (*Binah*). The "Covenant of the Tongue" refers to the Foundation <term>Yesod; the Sephirah associated with transmission and the procreative covenant</term> and intention. The tongue is called "Law" (*Chok*) because every law and judgment emerges from there. It is known that life comes from the side of Merit, and death from the side of Guilt. Specifically, "death and life are in the power of the tongue" <note>Proverbs 18:21</note>. The entire matter of the Law—whether of death or of life, whether it be the law of the conduct of every species, or the law of the movement and rotation [of the spheres], or the law of...

<meta>This page continues the commentary on the Sefer Yetzirah (The Book of Creation), shifting focus from the metaphysical "Tongue" to the physical and spiritual mechanics of speech. ### Maimonides <note>original: "HaRambam Zal"; though the text follows the commentary of the Ra'avad</note>, Chapter 2, Mishnah 3. The Ra'avad, may his memory be a blessing.

As it rests, you have the impressions of the voice, a voice that makes itself heard through the upper "weak mouth" and the "weakness," and like the breath <note>original: "Ruach," meaning both wind/breath and spirit</note> of those who wait who accompanied us in Gerar. Like rings, it is called breath, and like the breath that is compressed into the mouth, it is divided and "cut" into five junctions <note>referring to the five phonetic points of articulation</note>: the Throat, the Tongue, the Palate, the Lips, and the Teeth. This sound is called "Speech."

All the letters are divided into [various] parts, and each part tests for itself the "tool" to sound them. The tool unique to the letters **A, H, Kh, L, E** <note>original: AChahL"E; Aleph, Chet, He, Lamed, Ayin—here grouped as gutturals</note> is the drawing of the breath in the throat alone. And in the "house of swallowing" <note>the pharynx</note>, there they test **B, V, Ch, N, Y, T** and **L, M, S, Y**. Therefore, the [letter] **H** <note>He</note> was chosen from them for His Great Name, and the **H** in its pronunciation draws the **L** with it like **Kh-H** and draws even more with it like **H-Y**. Therefore, these were chosen for His Name, which is elevated above all laws. 

The letters **B, V, Y, P** <note>original: BoVi"P; the labials</note> were categorized for the "opening" [of the mouth], and because we produce pleasant sounds with the voice, it is a void without the use of the tool of the lips. Therefore, it was chosen with the **S** and two letters for His Explicit Name <term>Shem HaMephorash; the uniquely holy, four-letter name of God</term>. 

The letters **G, Y, Kh, K** <note>original: GiK"K; the palatals</note> were categorized for the palate. Since it was like a "basin" <note>original: gullah</note>, a tool of checking, and it was in everything yet hidden from everything, therefore they were perfumed at the head of the Explicit Name. Since He was the Beginning of all and the End of all, they were placed at the head of the network and at the end of the network, for He is First and He is Last. 

The letters **D, T, L, N, T** <note>original: DaTeLaN"T; the linguals</note> were categorized for the Tongue. Since the tongue was like a spring, and its "ceiling" is written on the wind-pipe <note>the trachea</note> which is placed upon one pillar alone, and the middle of the ceiling and its mass has nothing to lean upon, it stands by the spirit of **Shaddai** <term>Shaddai; a Divine name meaning "Almighty"</term> for its existence. Therefore, it is called God <note>original: El</note>, for without Him, his hand could not reach the second pillar. It is known that the crooked letter **Ayin** refers to an overturned cup, but its "ceiling" is from above and between the depth of its ceiling and its threshold, and thus it was carved.

<column-break/>

As in the *Book of Amulets* <note>original: Sefer HaKamia'at</note>, may his memory be a blessing, the author of the *Book of Creation* <note>Sefer Yetzirah</note> wrote: Thirty-two <note>though usually 22, the text refers to the 32 "Paths of Wisdom"</note> foundation letters are engraved in the voice. To the three [letters] in the voice of reasoning, and the **T**, they are "stranglers" <note>meaning they constrict the breath</note>, they are dedicated in their spirit. And the name **R-N-Ch** exists in all letters. In contrast to the **Cherubim** <note>celestial beings</note>, one must distinguish between spirit and spirit, fixed in the opening. 

From here [some are] "interchanged," and some are in the book, and some are from here in the middle. And these are from here in the throat, and these are from here in the lips. As found in every placement, twenty-two foundation letters are in eight places: there is **A, Ch, H, L, E** <note>AChahL"E</note>, and seven **G, L, S, Y** and **Ch, K, A, R**. For the reading of the host is from another placement: **B, V, Y, P**; **G, Y, Kh, K**; **D, T, L, N, T**; **Z, S, Sh, R, Tz** <note>the sibilants</note>. 

And there the twenty-two letters are tied to the tongue, for the tongue "licks" to open in the mouth with strength, and with a soft lip in the craft of resting. The "licking" is an inheritance of the licking to overturn the "beat" of the tongue. The "house of swallowing" supports the order of **G, Y, Kh, K** upon the cheeks of the tongue. The "thirty" of the tongue is for every lip, and they are recognized and called as good in the breadth of the tongue, opening with the sounds that emerge from the throat, between the lips and the tongue surrounding it. 

And for one who does not know the **Wisdom of Grammar** <term>Chokmat HaDikduk; the formal study of Hebrew language rules</term>, he will not understand this, for the proof is the Name itself. The placement of **A, Ch, H, L, E** is the throat. And it is an error in the hands of the grammarians who associate the [letter] **Resh** with this placement <note>the Ra'avad famously argues that Resh is a lingual or dental, not a guttural</note>, for the letter **Resh** is not of the placement of the throat. 

And when we tested the letters, we did not find a **Dagesh** <term>Dagesh; a dot in a Hebrew letter indicating a "hard" or doubled sound</term> in every instance as we encountered and scrutinized in his entire book, and in all the books of Jerusalem, nor in the *Book of the Great Ones*. However, in the [letter] **Chet**, we found a Dagesh in three places: the "Wave Offering" <note>original: Tenufah</note> is lacking a Dagesh; "And they shall bring to him the Omer" <note>the barley offering</note> which is on the Sabbath is also with a Dagesh; and "They shall bring to us, for the hand of our Beloved is good upon us" is also with a Dagesh. The reason for all of this is known through the **Secret of the Kabbalah**. This is already explained in the secret of the *Book of the Reed* <note>original: Sefer HaKanah; a 14th-century kabbalistic work</note>.

Regarding the verse "The voice of the Lord makes the hinds to calve," <note>original: "Kol Adonai yecholel ayalot"; Psalm 29:9</note> the explanation follows the concept of the "Voice of the World." The number of movements shall be fixed and moving, for there is a "spirit of life" within them. For the "tree of life" <note>referring to the Torah or the Hebrew alphabet</note> is a voice to those who hold fast to them, and within them is the "spirit of the living God." This is what the scripture means by "Who has measured the waters in the hollow of his hand," <note>original: "Mi madad be-sholo mayim"; Isaiah 40:12</note> meaning for the sake of the creatures in the water which were made through the holy letters. And He converted this [system] so that the head becomes the end. And He converted them from a lower state to an upper state and from an upper state to a lower state; from right to left and from left to right; from above to below and from below to above; from front to back and from back to front. And He turned one thing into its opposite. Their "division" <note>original: "perakan"</note> means that every species is according to its nature. This refers to the letters, for from their combination and speech, every structure was created. This explains the "Measure of All," which includes all souls and all existents in their forms and qualities, whether simple or compound, for every single thing is affected by actions known to those who possess the true hidden wisdom.

## The Ramb <note>likely Maimonides, though the content aligns with the mystical traditions of Nachmanides</note> of blessed memory | Chapter 2, Mishnah 3

His actions, as the ancient sages explained to me, follow the measure of Simeon the Just, who conducted himself in holiness and purity and remained constantly within the congregation of the Lord. Simeon the Just said to his students: "Know that the Ineffable Name <note>original: "Shem HaMeforash"</note> is divided into several parts, and it is entirely a secret of rectification, combination, joining, calculation, and form. The structure of the rectification is that the whole order comes into being from beginning to end, as is written in the verses regarding the Name of 72 <note>original: "Shem Ayin-Bet"; a divine name derived from three verses in Exodus 14:19–21, each containing 72 letters</note>: 'And he traveled,' 'And he came,' 'And he stretched out' <note>original: "Vayisa, Vayavo, Vayet"</note>. For the verse that comes from afar is his movement from beginning to end, and I have heard from my own mouth <note>likely referring to oral tradition</note> how it is harnessed and renewed until the end. This is the order of its reading, and thus it is with the 'doubled voice' exactly as it is, without omission and without addition.

Know that this secret is the essence of all things, like the contemplation of the mind and the contemplation of wisdom. It is the power of the pillar of the intellect and the essential character of its being, as by the counsel of the Most High and the students. Understand the secret of its explanation and its beginning, for my friend <note>or "beloved"</note> explained it thus:

**Yod-Kah** and **Vav-He** belong to him <note>The letters of the Tetragrammaton divided into pairs</note>; they are the sum of the writings of the wonders of Wisdom. Within them, all births are included. In the manner of 'the beginning of thought is the end of action,' blessed be the Name, the Hidden and Concealed One from the eyes of every living thing.

The **Power of Foundation** <note>original: "Koach Yesod"; refers to the Sefirah of Yesod</note> of the Name is the matter through which the Holy One, blessed be He, is studied; even the One who unites within His colors is included in His powers, rising and being exalted above them until there is no end to His glory and His height. This is because He discerns everything from the attribute of the Mind of Wisdom <note>original: "Moach ha-Chokhmah"</note> at the start of His actions. Furthermore, He is the order for everything that possesses a living soul. He is called 'The Living One who Sustains,' blessed be His name; He is the One who preceded all precedence, and His foundation is in the hiddenness of His being unto all eternity. He is the vitality that has no completion or end.

The **Power of Sustenance** is a thing that comes into being like a 'door' <note>original: "delet"; perhaps a wordplay on the letter Dalet</note> whose function is to sustain all that exists. Its strength comes from the foundation of every foundation, entirely for the secrets of all actions. The action takes effect along with the final secrets that He ordered in this way, as it is written in the words 'He began the power of the Aleph' <note>original: "koach Aleph"</note>. This is called the 'Cause of Causes' <note>original: "Olat ha-Olot"</note>, for it is the inner aspect of the action. There, the 'World of Understanding' <note>original: "Binah"</note> is named, along with the action of the ancient ones.

The **Power of Acquisition** <term>original: "Koach ha-Kinyan"; the power to bring potential into existence</term> is that by which the Holy One, blessed be He, created what was, what is, and what will be. He is His Name and His Name is everything; it is one thing in His existence. Blessed be the name of the Existent One whose heart is upright.

The **Power of Reconciliation** <note>original: "Koach Ratzui"</note> is a thing that softens unto infinity to complete all outcomes. Through it, the upper and lower realms are united, and from it comes the lineage of all that is included in His sum. For the actions of kindness are pure and chosen, and every transition of the end comes into being from this and through this.

The **Power of Kingship** <note>original: "Koach ha-Malchut"</note> is within His totality, and Kingship lacks nothing. Its products soften all the noble ones above and all creatures below, until the form of all creatures and the creation of all births are found from it. Blessed and praised be the Name of the Creator of births who establishes them forever and ever.

The **Power of Trial** <note>original: "Koach ha-Nisyon"</note> is the matter by which the Holy One, blessed be He, tests His creatures with all types of trials. This power has a revolving law; He tests based on the 'Essence,' for there is no essence higher than Him. Furthermore, this power is the unique movement of a thing whose law is imprinted, and it draws from the source of the 'Imprinted Word,' spreading into the fourfold square. This square is like a wide space where everything is pressed from within it. The power does not cease spreading at all, in the manner of a physical relationship, performing actions every day, as it is written: 'The right hand of the Lord is exalted, the right hand of the Lord does valiantly.' <note>Psalm 118:16</note> This is because all created things are small compared to the action and the service of His vitality. His will is exalted according to the measure of His will, which is the 'Actor of Kindness' called 'the Right Hand' in our language. 'The right hand of the Lord does valiantly' implies that when they do not do His will, the power of the Right Hand is diminished <note>literally "their shame"</note>, and the Holy Spirit will not rest upon them, even after a long time. It is called by the term 'Hand.' This is the Power of Trial about which the Ramban <note>Nachmanides</note> of blessed memory wrote. And some say that the explanation of this is that the Holy Spirit departed from the world; this is the 'Might of Trial' <note>original: "Gevurat Nisyon"</note>, blessed be He.

### The Ravad <note>Rabbi Abraham ben David of Posquières, a 12th-century legalist and mystic</note> of blessed memory, Chapter 2, Mishnah 3, and the Ramb <note>Likely Nachmanides (Ramban), who was deeply influential in the Kabbalistic circles of Spain, though the OCR says "Ramb" which usually denotes Maimonides</note> of blessed memory.

The Great [Name] which Rabbi Chesdai <note>likely referring to Hasdai Crescas or an earlier sage in the lineage</note> and the Secret transmitted today in our academy. From the inheritance of the ancients in our midst, we are able to deliberate. Through Joseph <note>possibly Joseph Gikatilla or a reference to the biblical Joseph's power of speech</note> in our midst, the speech of our lips is proven. Through the holiness of the commandments in our midst, the speech of your laws is proven. Let it be called the proof of the tongue. If it breaks forth in the midst of the speech of the lips, then you have the "fragrance of the perfume" <note>an allusion to the sweetness of divine revelation</note> in the mouth. This corresponds to the inheritance, and the mouth is its dwelling, corresponding to my work. For the virtue is primary, and the influence flows from it, and the incense is in the mouth. Thus it is spoken in his book. The parchment goes to the Master <note>original: "Yod-Yod-Vav-Reish," a shorthand for the Tetragrammaton</note> and it is necessary; and if it is the three Existences—was, is, and will be—He is the name of the essence, and all other names are dependent upon Him as accidents <note>term: accidents (Hebrew: "Mihrim"), a philosophical term meaning non-essential attributes that depend on a substance</note>. Every unique name is the Great, Mighty, and Awesome Assembly. It is the Voice that contains all other glories. Therefore, the Holy Torah says: **"I am El Shaddai"** <note>God Almighty</note>, who brought you forth from the loins of your ancestors; it does not say "I am Elohim," but uses the Ineffable Name <note>original: "Shem HaMeforash"</note> for those who would understand it and know its uniqueness. These are the words of our teacher, the Gaon Rabbeinu Bahya <note>Bahya ben Asher, a 13th-century Spanish commentator</note>, of blessed memory.

Moses Botril <note>a 14th-century scholar famous for his extensive commentary on the Book of Creation</note>, the great and holy, said: The Rabbi mentions this, and this wisdom was written to the God of the heavens. It became known to us through the words of the King of the Wheels <note>original: "Ofanim," referring to the celestial spheres or angelic orders</note> at the beginning. This is what we learned before the Rabbi, Master Jacob the Spaniard <note>original: "R' Yaakov Ha-Sefardi," a frequent source for Botril</note>, of blessed memory, whose secrets are the secrets of the Torah. When the matter became known to us, we saw it was a mighty secret. I have intended these completions and the generations of our elevation. It is proper for every wise man to fill his storehouse with His glory. It is delivered into his hand. Regarding this sage, I say: not to him belonged the strike of the great cup, for he was an aid. I shall give him merit in wisdom so that he will not be impoverished, nor shall these words grow faint. The secret of the word from my mouth is like one speaking, and this secret is the secret of all, and a secret in all that is mentioned. This is the commentary composed by the ancient philosopher, the great Kabbalist, the Abu-Solof <note>possibly a corruption of a name or a specific title</note>, the crown of Israel, Rabbi Judah ben [Hasdai] the Elder, of blessed memory. To my father's heart, I bring all faith, and the secret of the matter shall not be withheld from me. This is the end of his record, and the book of his majesty and splendor. This is the explanation of the Ineffable Name according to its ascents.

<column-break/>

Both of them refer to the Sefirah of the Crown <note>original: "Atarah," literally 'diadem,' the lowest Sefirah (Malchut) which acts as the interface with our world</note>. This is the one who judges the entire world at once. This is the secret of "Halchi" <note>a mystical acronym or cipher</note>. Thus the simple tongue, the hidden one, the strike of the **Aleph** of Understanding <note>term: Binah</note> and the **Yod** of Wisdom <note>term: Chochmah</note>. It justifies the whole world in the form of **"Justice, justice shall you pursue"** <note>Deuteronomy 16:20</note>. This refers to the Upper Justice <note>term: Yesod, the foundation</note> and the Lower Justice <note>term: Atarah/Malchut, the kingdom</note> with the power of the forty-two <note>referring to the 42-letter name of God</note>, and you shall bind the earth. 

Look in the *Book of Bahir* <note>original: "Sefer HaBahir," one of the earliest and most important Kabbalistic texts</note>. They were appointed if there was strength for the reversals. Because the letter **He** <note>represented by the number 5, or here possibly the combined 15</note> has three heads, it is like a receptacle for the thirty letters <note>original: "Lamed otiyot"</note> prepared to receive the Upper Power. For the thirty letters represent two tongues; for three letters at once, power descends to her. This is how the Crown <note>Atarah</note> receives from all the Sefirot above it. Therefore, its name is at the head of my requests. The letter **Lamed** <note>representing the number 30</note> descends in the moment of the binding and ascends. The letters of the "Vessel" <note>original: "Keli"</note> and "May He live" <note>original: "V'Yichi"</note> which are in the prophecy of the Son of Buzi <note>Ezekiel</note>. The sages explained that the letter **Vav** is the prophet of the division. For all victories <note>term: Netzachon, related to the Sefirah Netzach</note> in the spirits are the end of every burning. And this is the "Voice of the Righteous" <note>term: Tzaddik, associated with the Sefirah Yesod</note>, the foundation of the world. The letter **Tav** is the end of the "Beauty" <note>term: Tiferet</note> in the Sanctuary. Regarding this, learn from the letters that the **Shin** of the Throne <note>original: "Kisse"</note> is for the thirty, for this is what ascends above all letters until the **Chet** of the worlds. It indicates the power of His wisdom and the "sending of my hand"—meaning the power of the deep. This is His name, remembered in the scriptures, meaning all the words that are the secret of the beginning, which are summarized in the sealed **Yod**. For in the words of the worlds, there is a day to understand from this prayer the face of the dream and its memory of the Crowns.

### The Ramb <note>Likely referring to Rabbi Moses ben Nahman (Nachmanides), a 13th-century sage, though the abbreviation "Ramb" usually refers to Maimonides. Given the mystical content, Nachmanides is the more probable source</note> of blessed memory, Chapter 2, Mishnah 3.

In the beginning—and this entire matter is an allusion to the word *Atarah* <note>Crown; often associated with the lowest Sefirah, Malchut, which receives all divine influence</note>, meaning spiritual powers. There lies the secret of the beginning. For all these powers, each one has its own known name, and they are all arranged one above the other. And this is the **Primordial Light**, which is called **Ancient Wisdom** <note>original: "Hochmah Kedumah"</note>; it is spoken of as the **Wondrous Light**, the secret of the **Chashmal** <note>A mystical "speaking silence" or celestial glow described in Ezekiel's vision</note>, and the place of **Thick Darkness** <note>original: "Arphel"</note>. This exists in the highest plane, having the "aspect of greatness" which is called "Living," for the place of the Altar's vision is established there. There it is called **Cherub**; there it is called the **Wheels of the Chariot** <note>original: "Galgaley haMerkavah"</note>; for the pillars are of the surrounding atmosphere. It is also called the **Pargod** <note>The cosmic veil or curtain that separates the divine presence from the lower worlds</note>, and it resides in the **Throne of Glory**. This is the place of souls, which are called the "hollows of greatness," the secret of the upper arrangement called the **Highest Holy Palace**.

These sixty-three powers are revealed within the **Crown** <note>Keter</note> from the **Hidden Highest Crown**, which is called *Oman* <note>Artisan/Guardian</note>. The explanation is that the letter *Aleph* represents the *Omanah* <note>Nurturing/Faith</note>, from which Wisdom is nurtured. He, may He be blessed, existed before He created any thing; He was a Unity, founded in the Unfathomable. All things are suspended from Him, and all of them stand by His own power of existence. Therefore, His name is called *El Del* <note>The Poor God—likely a reference to the divine humbling itself to create</note>. He was not known [to any], but then in His knowledge He intended to bring forth all His works. He created with a "first force" called **Ancient Wisdom**. From it come hidden offspring and perfect offspring. It is called "Ancient" because its power is joined with the forty-three coverings of the Palaces.

The **Holy** corresponds to the **Guarded Crown** <note>Atarah</note> and its generations. There are the **Ten Sefirot of Nothingness** <note>original: "Sefirot Belimah," referring to the ten abstract dimensions of creation</note>. And this "Wisdom strengthens the wise more than ten rulers who are in the city" <note>A quote from Ecclesiastes 7:19, here interpreted as Wisdom's power over the Sefirotic structure</note>. This Wisdom is the end of light, and from the hanging of this power—which is called **Ancient Wisdom**—comes the **Light of Life**, pure and refined like fine gold. This is the writing and the engraving of the Highest Sapphires, which is called the **Infinite** <note>original: "Ain Sof"</note>, which cannot be grasped at all. This is the secret of the verse: "But where shall wisdom be found?" <note>Job 28:12; in Hebrew, "where" (*me-ayin*) is read as "from nothing," implying Wisdom emerges from the Nothingness of the Infinite</note>.

This highest prince is the **Will** <note>Ratzon</note> without limit. Why is it called Will? Because its true inheritance was from the beginning. It is also a refined light called the **Glory of the Lord**. Concerning this, it is said: "Who coverest Thyself with light as with a garment" <note>Psalm 104:2</note>, for He is delayed in His light, a brilliant splendor crowned with many colors, ascending unto the Infinite. It is called "Initial" because it was prior to all ancient things and in the wisdom of the wonders of His unity.

And this Wisdom is supreme over the seven Sefirot and is divided into six directions: Right and Left, Front and Back, Up and Down.

**Right** is the power of existence without tangible action, performing all works. This is what is meant by "The right hand of the Lord does valiantly," an increase of the **Holy Spirit**.

**Left** is an intellectual power without lack, containing within it attributes. It is the **Primary Loving-kindness** <note>original: "Chesed haRishoni"</note> which flows from its powers to everything, never becoming angry. Its nature never changed, and from it comes the Holy Spirit alone. From it, ten "fruits" of the sending of the Holy Spirit are magnified and prepared.

**Front** represents two powers that are the lightning-flash for all the powers revealed in the highest secret of His chariot; they are called **Favor and Grace** <note>original: "Chen v'Chesed"</note>, which are the **Face of Mercy**.

**Back** is the "thickness" of Wisdom, where the "Face of Understanding" <note>Binah</note> is the limit of the achievement of investigation. It is a power in itself, spreading into a natural force to depict forms and to fill everything.

**Up** is that which is called the **Highest Crown** <note>Keter Elyon</note>. This is a term for a secret; it is the "Highest All" which increases without end and humbles everything, for all existing things are nullified by its influence. This is the meaning of "majesty," as in "In the multitude of people is the king's majesty" <note>Proverbs 14:28</note>. Furthermore, the term **Crown** teaches that anyone who attains any knowledge through investigation, yet hides its secret, has a "rising power" attributed to them, as if they were crowned by it. Concerning this, it is said: "To be exalted because you have known Me and called upon Me."

The truth is that no intellect can grasp the knowledge of this matter in its true essence; rather, one can only negate from it what is revealed and what is grasped. For the "First Finding"—that is, the **Ancient Wisdom**—exists in the essence of its Divinity in its truth and with the unique quality of its unity. Furthermore, the Crown...

### Chapter 2, Mishnah 3: The Speaking Soul <note>original: "HaMedaber"—while this word can mean "the desert," in this philosophical context it refers to the "speaking faculty" or the rational human soul.</note>

The name of the "Speaking Soul" is "Valor and Strength," like a focused force. The **Intellectual Spirit** <note>original: "Ruach Muskhal"</note> is something that is distributed within the soul through the will, which can incline toward it and converse with it. As it is written: *and they went in the coldness* <note>original: "be-korach," likely a variant of a biblical reference</note> of the power of the Intellectual Spirit. From this power, they took knowledge of number and weight, of breadth and width, of sensory perceptions from handbreadth to handbreadth, from hand to arm, from circle to circle, of change and exchange, and of the straight and the upright. It is the strength of the dwelling-place, and of the girded **Seraphim** <note>Angelic beings of fire</note> and the sources that are attached and established in the perfection of the circle. This circle is divided into that which surrounds and that which is surrounded by twenty-two <note>A reference to the 22 letters of the Hebrew alphabet</note>; it is a surrounding force that stands and causes to stand, a cooled source, and a corner. All the generalities of this power return to the particulars, and the particulars return to the generalities. And all of them are weighed by the **Creator of All**, who is the foundation of everything and the essence of everything; they are included and decreed, and like their form, they are circular. Within the circles, they become heated and multiply, running like molten silver until all the various matters are joined one with another, and each part is taken for its good purpose. This is the "Intellectual Power" mentioned in the definition of Knowledge. Thus, whoever focuses on this secret and understands this hoped-for thing will be made [complete], and for him will arise from the circles the secret of the "Wings" <note>original: "Kenfot"—likely referring to the wings of the Chariot or the corners of the world</note>. And the circles, by the power of the wings, shall not be tested or judged, but shall perform the will of the **Highest Crown** <note>original: "Keter Elyon"—the highest of the ten Sefirot or divine emanations</note>, which is bound in the secret of **Wisdom** <note>Hochmah</note> and the secret of **Understanding** <note>Tevunah</note>. It contains within its essence the **Ineffable Name** <note>original: "Shem HaMeforash"—the four-letter name of God, the Tetragrammaton</note>, which is the strength <note>note: The Hebrew word for "strength" (Kach) has the numerical value of 28</note> for all quantity and the "womb" for all mercies. This "Wing" sustains all creatures. Blessed be the Name of the Giver of Knowledge.

From it comes the **Sensed Power** <note>original: "Koach Murgash"</note>. This is a thing that points to the matter of the **Primordial Air** <note>original: "Avir Kadmon"</note>, which is the hollow of the waters and the secret of all saltiness and the foundation of matter. For all saltiness is suspended in the air, and the air is its conductor; for heat is the life of the air, and heat brings forth saltiness, and saltiness accompanies the air. It is like a storm-wind that praises, seen from within by all those who are hidden, because the air sustains them within the limits of the vitality that moves within the body. Regarding this, it was said that before the world was created, and before any creature was brought forth, the Primordial Air was alone, and there was no "speaker" <note>or "desert"</note> concerning it from any side at all. This was like the Holy One, Blessed be He, who was hidden in His name, and His glory was not recognized at all until He sought this Air and, through mercy and movement, His glory was revealed in the radiance of the path that guides with a single spirit. They called this **Ancient Wisdom** <note>Hochmah Kedumah</note>. This is what is written: *Behold, God is exalted in His power; who is a teacher like Him?* <note>Job 36:22</note>.

The essence of the knowledge of the Primordial Air was not named or revealed as the source of the creation of His creatures, even here below in the "Assembly of Israel" <note>original: "Knesset Yisrael"</note>, as it is written: *and the spirit of God hovered* <note>Genesis 1:2</note>. Because of this, they see in secret that "according to the intelligence [of the man, so is he praised]" <note>Proverbs 12:8</note>. For he said: "I have seen it and you shall see," meaning that in the upper standing and the distance of His strengths, there is no ability for man to grasp them, even though "corrupt thoughts" <note>skepticism or false philosophies</note> pass over him. He attributes them to the Creator—may He be blessed—for they are always before Him, as His eyes are upon them according to the level of His glory. Blessed be the Name of Him who is exalted in His glory.

**Innate Power** <note>original: "Koach Mutba"</note> is a thing found beneath the "Scroll of Rest," meaning it is with matter. [The text here is somewhat obscured] regarding the spirit belonging to matter; that is, all existing things have their good found within them and through their necessity they were searched out—by way of example—due to the great subtlety of the beginnings of existence. Regarding this matter, He said: *And you shall see my back* <note>Exodus 33:23</note>, meaning you shall grasp that which is attached to Me and joins with Me—that is to say, all created beings. Furthermore, it refers to the natural generality of all created things in their proper place, in the matter of the Holy Hiddenness. Blessed be the Name of Him who is exalted in holiness.

**Weak Power** <note>original: "Koach Chalush"</note> is a thing that is renewed within the "saltiness of the world," its beginning and its action. The principle foundation is as we said: "He established thirty-two paths of wisdom," meaning the calculation of the wise and their meaning regarding the **Living God** <note>Elohim Chayim</note>, which is the secret of the Ineffable Name. Through it, swarming things, birds, and the fruit of the seed were brought into being, a power upon the perfect natural foundation and its form. Furthermore, it is the essence of all the secrets included in the Book of the Work of

### RAMBAM of Blessed Memory, Chapter 2, Mishnah 3: The RABENZEL <note>original: "Ha-Rabenzel"—likely a shorthand reference to a specific commentator, possibly Abraham ibn Ezra or a similar medieval authority.</note>

He said: The staff <note>A metaphor for the central axis of the cosmic wheel</note> has a few protruding **vertebrae** <note>original: "hulyot"—meaning segments, links, or joints; here referring to the individual letters as segments of the celestial sphere</note> that are formed with engravings all around the surface of the **sphere** <note>original: "galgal"—the celestial wheel or sphere of the universe</note>. The sphere stands within itself, and those engravings are the "hollows of the hips" <note>A metaphorical reference to the sockets where the segments connect</note> which surround the bodies of the vertebrae. He engraved them like a kind of ring; for while the force is expanding within them, it measures and binds from every side until the entire structure rises as one. Thus was the engraving around the vertebrae, upon the bodies of the vertebrae themselves. Afterward, he took the vertebrae and stood them one after another like a wall, connected in the language of the sages as a "profane wall" <note>original: "chol chon"—a play on words between 'hulyot' (vertebrae) and 'chol' (secular/profane/sand)</note>. So too, the building blocks of the vertebrae, which are joined from the bodies of the sphere, were stood one after the other until they encompassed the entire row. The firmament is like a kind of rod. This is the secret of the "fixed letters in the sphere" <note>A central concept in Sefer Yetzirah where the 22 letters are literally fixed into the fabric of the universe</note>, which are arranged in a **lozenge** shape <note>original: "me-uyanet"—diamond or rhombus shaped</note>. The explanation is that the "thicket" <note>original: "skhakh"—referring to the layered arrangement</note> of the letter-vertebrae—those letters we have described—passes through the thickness of the sphere. The thickness of the sphere is a distance of five hundred years' journey. All the vertebrae are like a "socketed hip" and are treaded upon from the outside. Their arrangement over that writing is like a lozenge. These numbers of "windows" <note>original: "chalonot"—likely referring to the spaces between letters</note> are for the layers that are fixed and protruding in the sphere. And the sphere "turns," meaning the sphere rotates and encompasses while the vertebrae remain fixed within it, yet they move from their place as vertebrae-signs which are like a wall established in the sphere. The sphere returns from every side to its creation, returning from all **Judgment and Might** <note>original: "Din and Gevurah"—the harsher divine attributes</note> to return and bring near. Every "Face" <note>A mystical aspect or dimension</note> turns from all **Mercy** <note>original: "Rachamim"</note> and returns from all Judgment below. Thus, our Sages of blessed memory said: He partnered the **Attribute of Mercy** with the **Attribute of Judgment** and created the world. Know that the measurements of the vertebrae for every "Face" are reversed; whatever Judgment is received behind, you will not find it the same way in the front. From here it will be clarified for you that there are vertebrae

<column-break/>

in the sphere, both **Front and Back**.
We protect every branch in its engraving specifically, as well as in its obligation. According to the "Correction of the Spring" <note>likely a reference to a specific mystical technique or text</note>, it is better for it to emerge in this alternating fashion so that one may know the truth when walking in a distant way. For if it were not arched there, that which rises from the spring would be hidden from him. Therefore, there are signs and windows for it. And therefore the Sage <note>The author of Sefer Yetzirah</note> wants to clarify this: "A plague of death to life." Our teacher, Rabbi Hai <note>referring to Hai Gaon, 939–1038 CE</note> of blessed memory, explained in the book called *The Voice of the Lord in Strength*: All the "Faces" are one single body. They are all twenty-two vertebrae <note>The 22 letters of the Hebrew alphabet</note>. When joined in a flash, Aleph with Bet, and Gimel with Dalet <note>Techniques of letter permutation</note>, there are eleven pairs, for eleven times two is twenty-two. This is the secret of the division of the vertebrae in the way of the "layers" in her house; this is not just a parable but a secret of the testimonies. "The sphere returns front and back"—this means to say the wheel of the vertebrae turns front and back. Just as it was said in the imagination of the "height," so it is with the "Face." The sphere returns and becomes a "sign" and "vision" for the return. This is the sign that the author of *Sefer Yetzirah* took: a person should contemplate the intelligence that exists between "Front and Back" in the form of the sphere. When the vertebrae roll, it is like a word that has "Nothing" <note>original: "Ayin"</note> within it; above it is "Pleasure" <note>original: "Oneg"</note> and there is nothing in "Evil" <note>original: "Ra"</note> above "Plagues" <note>original: "Nega-ei"</note>. The explanation is that "Good" and "Evil" are two high wheels; that which is "Good" took "Height" and "Pleasure," and corresponding to "Evil," which is "Absence," it took "Below" and "Plague." <note>This is a classic Kabbalistic teaching: the Hebrew words for Pleasure (O-N-G) and Plague (N-G-A) use the same letters; their meaning depends on the arrangement of the "links" on the wheel.</note> If so, the person who contemplates this wisdom must understand the alternating rods; they shall rejoice in the wheel of the rod. The "rod" is a good action, and action within their essence is a rod in the way that it deals with the attribute of "Pleasure" and "Plague." And this is what was meant by specifying "Front and Back."

### Chapter 2, Mishnah 3 – The RAMBAZAL <note>original: "Ha-RAMBAZAL"—likely referring to a medieval philosophical commentator like Rabbi Moses bar Solomon of Salerno.</note>

We have thus learned of the pillars of light, balanced and precious, which are called the symbols of Ancient Wisdom. Among them is the group called the **Fivefold** <note>original: "chamusha"</note>, which is the word **Holy** <note>original: "Kadosh"</note>; it is the cause of simplicity, existence, and the continuation of movement in every revelation. They are the guide for death and the complete stature, as it is said: "For actions are done by the power of a distant response that regulates time." The principle stems from the letter *Lamed*. The "distant response" refers to spiritual matters that guide the eye, all of which pertain to the light of the *Hanukkah* <note>The "dedication" or "illumination"</note> and time. The matter of Ancient Wisdom is clarified from the point of the Secret. This furnace is linked and included within the simple furnace of "Death is spared from speaking" <note>original: "mavet chas mi-mallelet"—a cryptic mystical phrase regarding the silence of the void</note>.

Furthermore, it is said: "Spared from arising like a heavenly mound." In every month of its moon, there is a branch, a spread, and a fruit; the power of man is to the East and his intention is to the West, where the Divine Presence <note>original: "Shekhinah"</note> glides like a basin <note>or "sprinkling bowl"</note>. He imagines in his mind the specific thing upon the four points, such as the part from which all limbs spread; these are the inheritance for the four of them in the secret of the engravings that extend from every place. Everything is the Emanated Glory: **Wisdom, Thick Darkness, the Throne of the Divine Presence, the Wheel, and the Path.** Each of these is divided into three parts.

**Electrum** <note>original: "Chashmal"—the mystical glowing substance seen in Ezekiel's vision</note> is one part. **Michael** is the second part, the commander of his four Living Creatures <note>original: "Chayot"—the celestial beings carrying the Divine Throne</note>. The third part is the light of **Peniel**. The fourth part is the **Daughter of Fire**, which was the great flame above him, as it is said: "For the Lord your God is a consuming fire." The second dwelling, in which is the **Thick Darkness**, consists of four parts with him: **Gabriel** is the second of the host of the four Living Creatures; the third angel is **Tevriel**; and the fourth is the secret of the Upper Holiness, the child of the heights. The fourth part is the **Rising Ones**. The third dwelling in the **Throne of the Divine Presence** consists of four parts with him: **Uriel** is the second; **Dadriel** is the third; and among the four Living Creatures, the fourth is the **Daughter of Holiness**. The fourth part is the **Great Wheel** itself for the Unique One: **Raphael** is within it; **Carmiel** is the third; the second to the last of the four Living Creatures is the fourth part, the **Daughter of Wisdom**.

Behold, you have seven foundations; they are seven above corresponding to what is below. They are called the **Body of the Divine Presence**: Ancient Air, Wisdom, Understanding, Kindness, Strength, Beauty, Glory, Victory, Foundation, and Kingdom <note>These are the ten Sephirot, the divine attributes through which God interacts with the world.</note>. These are the ten Sephirot included in the secret of what is explained by way of the "desired wrappings" and the secrets of the emanations. Thus far the words of the great Kabbalistic Rabbi, Rabbi Judah son of Rabbi Nissim, of blessed memory.

### The RAMBAZAL, Mishnah 4, Chapter 2 – The RA’AVAD of Blessed Memory <note>Rabbi Abraham ben David of Posquières, a famous 12th-century critic and commentator.</note>

<margin>
Thirty-two paths are the foundation of Wisdom; corresponding to them are the Sephirot, a letter within a letter until the center. And he said that there are...

->The Commentary of Nachmanides <note>original: "RAMBAN"—Rabbi Moses ben Nachman, a 13th-century sage.</note><-

**The Wheel:** It is called a wheel <note>original: "galgal"</note> because of the letters that roll or cycle. **With 231 gates:** This is the number of the alphabet when paired. There is no "gate" smaller than two letters; thus, there are 231 gates <note>The number of possible two-letter combinations in the 22-letter Hebrew alphabet (22 × 21 ÷ 2 = 231).</note>. When you join *Aleph* with every other letter, there are 21; twenty times 21 would be 442 witnesses and sixty; and at the end of the verse, to reverse them, they are 465. **Forward and backward:** "Forward" refers to Mercy, and "backward" refers to Judgment. **A sign for the matter:** This sign is for everyone, that the emanated intellect brings about "clothing" and the weighing of measures, so as to decide from their letters by way of "dreams," which is where the primary hidden treasure lies. **Pleasure (O-N-G) and Plague (N-G-A):** These are the exact same letters <note>In Hebrew, Ayin-Nun-Gimel (Pleasure) and Nun-Gimel-Ayin (Plague) share the same root letters but in a different order.</note>, and their "living essence" <note>their spiritual vitality</note> is the sign for the order of the letters as they rotate in this manner.

# CHAPTER 2, MISHNAH 4 — THE RA’AVAD, OF BLESSED MEMORY

There are fixed letters, which are in the celestial sphere <note>original: "galgal"—the wheel of the zodiac or the cosmic cycle</note>, and there are returning and revolving letters. These exist through the change of the *permutation cycle* <note>original: "salglos," likely a corruption of the Greek 'syllogos' or a technical term for the rearrangement of the Sephirot</note> of the Sephirot <note>The ten divine emanations in Kabbalah</note>. There is an order for selection and an order that is reversed for the "Chariot" <note>original: "merkavah"—referring to the mystical study of the Divine Throne</note>. A sign for this matter is found in every transformation, nickname, and reversal: a child is born from the change in the logical order of the letters. It is difficult to live through *Delight* <note>original: "Oneg" (ענ"ג)</note> derived from the letters of *Plague* <note>original: "Nega" (נג"ע)</note>. For "Plague" is evil, and there is no "Goodness" <insert>Kindness</insert> higher than "Delight," and there is no "Evil" lower than "Plague." 

All of them revolve in a cycle; this is like that, through the change of orders. Their "Openings" <note>The vowels or gateways</note> show the action of the language. One must understand that the written letters and the changes that return to "sickliness" <note>referring back to the concept of Nega/Plague</note> are those orders of letters that are fixed to return in the "holiness of the sanctities" <note>original: "kadosh mikdashei"</note> of the letters of Mercy.

### THE RA’AVAD, OF BLESSED MEMORY

How did He weigh Aleph with all of them? The explanation is that the first Alphabet <note>original: "Alpha Beta"</note> begins with Aleph according to the order of *AL-B* <note>The first pair in the 231 Gates</note> for the living. And after *KL-B*, there arrives *PL-K, RS-T*. Thus, Aleph is with Bet and all the other letters with them. And afterward...

And therefore Aleph [comes first], and Aleph goes out with Nun. And there are letters that are paired one by one with them, and if so, they are always in Aleph and emerge through power with them.

And afterward, Gimel emerged, and then Dalet, and then Heh, and then Vav, and then Zayin, and then Chet, and then Tet, and then Yod, and then Kaf (18, 20), and then Lamed (13), and then Mem, and then Nun, and then Samekh, and then Ayin, and then Peh, and then Tzadi, and then Kof. 

There will remain *CH-L* <note>Chet and Lamed</note> in the middle... Aleph with all of them. And afterward, He measured so that He would cast the Kof to this combination, which is far from its being—in the end, against this, this is the city of all that is... He skips according to the first order, and there remains in the middle *S* <note>Samekh</note> and *Z* <note>Zayin</note>.
The Law <note>original: "Halacha"</note>.

### THE RAMBAZAL, OF BLESSED MEMORY <note>Likely Rabbi Moses Botarel, a 14th-century commentator known for his extensive and sometimes enigmatic commentary on Sefer Yetzirah.</note>

"How did He weigh them and transpose them"—let it be said that when He weighed them, all letters were in the "Holy Weight" <note>original: "Shekel HaKodesh"</note>, and nothing was missing from the number. Concerning this study, the Sages said: "From the number of bodies..." and they did not say "bodies" in vain. 

They transposed to create the *S* of the Sephirot and their simplicity, for they are absorbed in their Creator. As a hint: "His Creator" <note>Boro</note> to the strengthening of God <note>El</note>—**Raphael** <note>The angel of healing</note>. 

[The combinations] shall only be in the manner of the 22 letters by way of guarding the letters one within the other, like "the language of his house" <note>an idiomatic way to describe phonetic families</note>. Thus, in His holy book, the letters are exchanged, for we find that one can say "to rejoice" <note>original: "ya'aloz"</note> using the letter *Samekh* <note>יעלוס</note> or the letter *Tzadi* <note>יעלוז</note>. One is accepted like the other, just as one letter comes in the place of its companion. 

As in the phrase "the wall in the flesh" <note>ha-kotel</note>, or "the crown" <note>ha-koter</note>, or "to stir" <note>merachesh</note>. We find the letter *Shin* <note>ש</note> exchanged with *Ayin* <note>ע</note> in the word for "Wisdom" <note>Chokhmah</note>.

## COMMENTARY OF THE RAMBAN, OF BLESSED MEMORY <note>Rabbi Moses ben Nachman, or Nachmanides, a 13th-century giant of Torah and Kabbalah.</note>

"How did He weigh them" one against the other: first, twenty-two letters; second, eleven; and so with all of them. And when he is at the "heart" <note>the center</note> of the letter, facing the right, he skips toward the left. 

"How did He place them": letters that are in their [natural] order to see those that are not in their order. This is to teach that anyone who has all of them, even if he has no speech, [can understand] all speech. For whatever one can produce in speech, one can form in the letters. 

"And it emerges in one Name": these are all the "Gates" <note>the 231 letter-pair combinations</note> through which the Name revolves. And they are all accounted for in one Name.

While the previous page focused on the complex permutations of the "231 Gates," this page transitions into the fifth Mishnah of the second chapter, which explains how God transformed primordial chaos into tangible reality using the letters as "columns" or structural foundations.</meta>

And the thread of kindness hovers over us today, and this is the secret of **Sh-N** <note>original: "ש"ן" - This likely refers to the numerical value 350 or a mystical acronym related to the soul's cycles</note> for every person; "God works two or three times with a man" <note>A quote from Job 33:29, interpreted here as the cycles of the soul</note>. If so, he created the soul of every living thing by the power of the Name, and by the power of all that is destined to be preserved. Thus, all of creation and all of speech gained merit through one Name. For all created beings are like bundles; the power of the "Faces" <note>The *Partzufim* or Divine Countenances</note> are contained within them, as he said in his chapter: "in them is the soul of every living thing." All speech is comprised of nothing but the five points of articulation <note>The five locations in the mouth where letters are produced: throat, palate, tongue, teeth, and lips</note>, and they are all found within the twenty-two letters. Thus, all creation and all speech gained merit through one Name, as was said in the first chapter: "He was spirit from spirit," meaning Wisdom, which is the second *Sefirah* <note>An emanation or divine attribute</note>; its nourishment comes from the Supernal Crown (*Keter*), and this is how "One" becomes "One."

---

### The Rambaz, of blessed memory
He formed reality from chaos (*Tohu*) <note>The primordial unformed state of the universe</note> as a literal substance, and made His non-existence into His existence, etc. This refers to the totality of the world, words of "Litho" <note>possibly a corruption of a Greek or Latin term for "stone" or "void"</note>, meaning from absolute non-existence. "And He hewed columns" — this means that in the second *Sefirah* there are great columns, and they are the columns that ascend.

### Mishnah 5
**He formed reality from Chaos (*Tohu*) as a literal substance, and made His non-existence into His existence. He hewed great columns from air that cannot be grasped. This is the sign: He gazes and speaks, making all of creation and all words into one Name. The sign for this matter: Twenty-two [letters] which are counted as one body.**

### The Ra'avad, of blessed memory
And His Names literally ascended. He specified the Names of the Ancient One, for the spheres were caused to speak from Chaos (*Tohu*). He planted His grace and established [it] for the structures of your wisdom. Words of "Selina" <note>A difficult term, likely referring to a type of mental ascent or reasoning</note> — not like an image or intellect, but rather all the wisdoms of the sphere were gathered to know what it is.

---

The secret of the Three Mothers, Seven Doubles, and Twelve Simples <note>The three categories of the Hebrew alphabet according to the Sefer Yetzirah</note>: through these existences, they brought forth ten simple words. Every effect in the world is "Litho" — all things that are found. And He hewed 
->great<- 
columns.
